title: Common-degree evaluation detects the supplied Brown square
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a normed finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a field $k$ whose characteristic is prime and different from $\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$, a $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$, and a specified normalized compact-support comparison family $C$ [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. Use the actual functors, maps, supplied pairs, and normalized Brown data of [def-pur-reconstructed-refinement-data]. Let $w:c\to d$ be a refinement, $D_1,D_2$ normalized Brown packages, $L$ an integral object on $Y$, and $A_1,A_2$ supplied systems over $L$. Let $s:A_2.\operatorname{system}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_1.\operatorname{system}$ be an actual derived-system isomorphism and let $r\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose each finite evaluation in the first site package sends both supplied systems to objects concentrated in degree $r$, and sends $\theta_1\circ s$ and $\rho_{12}\circ\theta_2$ to the same map. Then $\theta_1\circ s=\rho_{12}\circ\theta_2$ as actual derived-system maps. This asserts detection only in the common single-degree case.

proof.text:
exact conservative evaluations detect that both supplied systems are
concentrated in degree r. Their good-truncation maps identify them with the shifted
heart. The target is isomorphic to the first supplied system via theta, so it is
concentrated in that same degree. On the shifted heart the degree-r cohomology
functor is fully faithful. The exact evaluation comparisons carry its map to the
cohomology of each displayed evaluated map. Joint faithfulness of evaluation on
ordinary strict coefficient systems identifies these heart maps. Full faithfulness
of the shifted heart then gives the asserted equality in the derived category.
No faithfulness of evaluations on arbitrary derived morphisms is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem reconstructedRefinementSingleDegree :
    (∀ (c d : Compactification f)
    (D₁ : At l E k C X Y f c) (D₂ : At l E k C X Y f d) (w : c.Refinement d)
    (L : CondensedERealization.Integral l E Y.scheme)
    (A₁ : D₁.Supplied L) (A₂ : D₂.Supplied L) (r : ℤ)
    (s : A₂.system ≅ A₁.system),
    (∀ n : ℕ, ((D₁.transport.siteX.proEvaluation.evaluation n).obj A₁.system).IsGE r ∧
      ((D₁.transport.siteX.proEvaluation.evaluation n).obj A₁.system).IsLE r) →
    (∀ n : ℕ, ((D₁.transport.siteX.proEvaluation.evaluation n).obj A₂.system).IsGE r ∧
      ((D₁.transport.siteX.proEvaluation.evaluation n).obj A₂.system).IsLE r) →
    (∀ n : ℕ, (D₁.transport.siteX.proEvaluation.evaluation n).map
        (s.hom ≫ (D₁.pair L A₁).theta.hom) =
      (D₁.transport.siteX.proEvaluation.evaluation n).map
        ((D₂.pair L A₂).theta.hom ≫ mate D₁ D₂ w L A₁ A₂)) →
    s.hom ≫ (D₁.pair L A₁).theta.hom =
      (D₂.pair L A₂).theta.hom ≫ mate D₁ D₂ w L A₁ A₂)
